features.title: Live budgets
features.body: Every team sees its own bucket update as spend happens, not at month-end reconciliation.

features.title: Delegated keys
features.body: Hand a scoped key to a sub-team or a robot; reclaim what it does not use.

features.title: Audit trail
features.body: Every consumption and replenishment is timestamped and attributable, no export required.
